newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BT declines comment on Van Miert's merger remarks.
newsitem.headline: BT declines comment on Van Miert's merger remarks.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc declined to comment on Monday on EU competition chief's remarks that the European Commission will clear BT's merger with MCI Communications Corp on the condition the firms confirm "remedies to competition problems".

"We're discussing with the Commission. The press release of January 30 listed the issues," BT's head of European Union affairs told Reuters. He declined to comment on the remedies offered or even if they had been offered.

European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert was reported by Belgian news agency Belga as telling a conference organised by the University of Leuven: "If they confirm suggestions they have already made, I will be in a position to approve the merger."
Van Miert's spokesman confirmed the news report. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
